A bad experience.
Took my Cocker Spaniel for a trim early last year. Stated I wanted a trim like he'd given her pup several times before.
Ended up collecting a dog I didn't recognise. Cut ridiculously short. Changed colour from lovely red to beige.
Colour has never come back since and coat condition is ruined.
As a dog groomer, he should have known never to cut a Cockers 'dual' hair so short. Never again.
